fields.name: Event or Group Name#Event, or state group name
Group value#Value to set the state or switch to
Music action list#List of music actions to perform. All will be performed when the tag is called.
Event priority#0s will always play until a higher number is set, then only an even higher number will play after that until a reset from the sound marker occurs

options: StartEvent#Saved  event to start music. Will call a wwise event. Restored on load
StopEvent#Saved event to stop music. Will call a wwise event. Restored on load
ControlEvent#Saved event for control info. Will call a wwise event. Restored on load
TriggerEvent#NOT saved event for one-offs. Will call a wwise event. NOT restored on load
TriggerEventTracked#Same as trigger event but timing is tracked for event system
SetState#set the state group to the value. Restored on load
SetSwitch#set the switch group to the value. Restored on load
SetRTPC#set the rtpc value. Restored on load
SetPriority#use rtpc value field. sets the music playback priority. Use with caution
